tasks.task: Plan IT for a new or moving office

items.when: When an office opens, moves, switches platform or a new manager inherits IT that grew unplanned
When internet, Wi-Fi, devices, accounts, backups and help must be sorted in the right order
Before the plan, to see which basic safeguards an office this size needs first
When the budget is tight, to compare a lean and a fuller set-up with costs and dates
When the office runs on Microsoft 365 and needs users, mail, Teams and security set up by script

tasks.task: Build a device and licence register

items.when: When nobody knows how many devices, licences and subscriptions exist, who has them or when they renew
When the fields are agreed and you need a clean workbook with no made-up rows
When card and invoice exports are to hand, to find duplicate and unused subscriptions
Each month, to see renewals with notice deadlines and a keep or cancel action for each
When an old device list is handed over, to find gaps, duplicates and odd values

tasks.task: Run the IT side of starters, movers and leavers

items.when: When someone joins, changes role or leaves and accounts must change in the vendor's own order
When the same Microsoft 365 user steps repeat and should be scripted
When Google Workspace steps should be run from the command line, not clicked each time
When a leaver's handover and HR steps must line up with the day access is removed

tasks.task: Check tenant security and rank the changes

items.when: When a Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace tenant needs checking against vendor and public baselines
When the client wants Cyber Essentials, to list the gaps to fix before applying
When the fix list is long, to put the basic safeguards in order for a small office
When a control is proposed, to ask what it protects, what it costs and what risk is left

tasks.task: Tighten sign-in rules and staff phishing habits

items.when: When sign-in habits are unknown, to rank the gaps and write a one-page policy
When staff need one page of phishing rules and a ten-minute drill
When a new sign-in rule starts, to explain the change to staff in plain words
When a breach notice arrives, to separate what is known from what is feared before acting

tasks.task: Plan backups and prove a restore works

items.when: When a small office needs to know what is backed up, where, and how long a restore takes
Before choosing tools, to set how much loss and downtime the business can take
When backups exist but nobody has restored one, to plan a safe test with an evidence log
After a restore test, to compare the evidence with the recovery targets and list the gaps
When the plan assumes every step works, to test hand-offs, warnings and a missed step

tasks.task: Write an admin script that is safe to run twice

items.when: When a repeat chore needs a PowerShell or Bash script with a dry run and clear logging
When the chore also needs a schedule or trigger, not only the script
When the script changes files or accounts, to build it in small steps with a test first
Before a Windows script is trusted, to catch operator, quoting and error handling mistakes
When the script runs on a cron schedule, to confirm the next run times and catch silent mistakes
When you can work in the client's script folder and run the dry run yourself

tasks.task: Fix a script that fails or does the wrong thing

items.when: When an old script must be repaired and made safe to run a second time
Before changing any line, to prove the cause of the failure with evidence
When a PowerShell script fails oddly, to check for the common language traps first
When the job is slow or fails on the server and the script may not be the cause

tasks.task: Review a script before it is run

items.when: When a script came from a colleague, a website or an old scheduled job and is not yet trusted
When the script is long, to review it for bugs, security gaps and risky commands
When an AI wrote the script, to catch repeated logic and the usual AI mistakes
When scripts hold passwords or keys, to find them and plan how to rotate and store them
Before a job is scheduled, to find double runs, missing approvals and other ways it can fail

tasks.task: Pull what is needed from logs and command output

items.when: When a one-line command or short script must pull errors, sign-ins or sizes from logs
When an admin tool returns JSON and you need a command that filters or sums it
When the logs are being read to explain a slow or failing system

tasks.task: Write staff IT how-tos and troubleshooting trees

items.when: When the same questions keep coming in and staff should fix them alone
When past tickets and vendor docs are to hand and you need short, searchable articles
When one task needs exact steps, what to do if it fails and who to call
When a guide uses admin words, to rewrite it in the words staff say and test it read aloud
Before the set is shared, to read it as a non-technical member of staff and list what stalls them
When a how-to explains the system and not the fix, to cut it to a plain example

tasks.task: Set up a first-line help process and escalation rules

items.when: When requests arrive unsorted, to class each one, rank it and draft a first reply
When a problem must go to a vendor or outside IT firm with the impact and steps tried
When the office has a help desk tool and wants reply templates and a triage routine
When guides are scattered, to decide what to write down, where it lives and who keeps it fresh

tasks.task: Design the file and permission structure

items.when: When files are scattered and nobody knows who can see what in SharePoint or Shared drives
When the structure could follow teams or follow projects, to compare two shapes before picking
When the structure must also say where procedures and guides live

tasks.task: Plan a move off an old file server or tool

items.when: When the move is part of a wider clean-up of accounts, devices and backups
When data moves between tools, to get a map of fields, checks and a way back
When staff must keep working during the move, to plan each step with a check and a rollback
When the move also ends a contract, to plan notice dates and a staged switch

tasks.task: Write IT policies staff will read

items.when: When staff already use AI tools and there is no rule on what data may go into them
When people work from home on mixed devices and the rules are unwritten
When the policy needed is about passwords, sign-in codes and shared accounts
When a policy is approved, to turn it into a plain announcement staff can follow

tasks.task: Handle the first hour of a security incident

items.when: When a mailbox sends spam, a ransom note appears or someone typed a password into a fake page
When an alert arrives, to set severity, who to tell and what to preserve
When staff or customers must be told, to draft the first notice, updates and all-clear
After the event, to write a no-blame report with causes, owners and open facts
When the incident shows a weak procedure, to redraft it and track the prevention actions
When panic is driving the response, to hold to what the evidence shows was exposed

tasks.task: Run the monthly IT health check

items.when: In the first working week of each month, from the tenant, backup and device exports
When there is a server or cloud set-up, to check alerts, backups, patches and access for gaps
When domains and certificates are renewed by hand, to flag leftovers and weak registrar access
When an internet or IT provider keeps missing targets, to score them and claim credits
When the owner wants one page with status, risks and the decisions needed

tasks.task: Set up email sender records so mail is trusted

items.when: When office mail lands in spam or the domain has no SPF, DKIM or DMARC records
When the records are in place, to score the settings and get the exact fixes

tasks.task: Write runbooks for server and admin chores

items.when: When a service needs written steps for maintenance, faults and rollback
When the office manager will run the chore and needs it tested and taught
When old runbooks exist, to find missing owners, stale pages and gaps
On a schedule, to flag runbooks that no longer match the systems

tasks.task: Set rules for AI agents and add-ons with admin access

items.when: When an AI agent will act in an admin console, to set its permissions and risky-action rules
Before an AI add-on or skill is installed, to find risky code and hidden data leaks
Before staff data goes into an AI tool, to check its terms on training and liability
When the tenant has Copilot, to know what it can see and do before rules are written

tasks.task: Choose or switch an IT tool or provider

items.when: When backup, device management or help desk tools are being compared against real needs
Before signing, to flag renewal traps, price rises, uptime and data terms
When the choice replaces a tool in use, to plan the exit and a staged switch

always.when: Before a guide, plan or policy is shared, to catch typos and a system named two ways
When a plan cites vendor settings, limits or rules, to tie each to a dated source or cut it

helpers.when: When an incident is serious, or the client needs a full security review or a formal standard
When the work is servers, cloud accounts, pipelines or monitoring rather than office IT
When joiner, leaver or help requests should flow between tools without a script to maintain
When the how-to set grows into a full help centre or staff handbook
When a breach may need reporting, or retention and privacy rules must be checked for a region
When licences, internet or an IT support contract need quotes compared and terms negotiated

gaps: No library item designs a SharePoint or Shared drive structure with permission groups, or Teams and Chat channel rules
No library item builds a device and licence register; only subscriptions are covered
No library item runs joiner, mover and leaver steps in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace in the vendor's order; only the HR side exists
No library item checks a Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace tenant against vendor, CISA SCuBA or ENISA baselines
No library item reviews a Bash script for unsafe patterns; only PowerShell has a pitfall checker
No library item writes regex or a log parser for sign-in, mail or backup logs
No library item plans office internet, Wi-Fi, printers and network kit for a small office
No library item covers device management and patching: Intune, Jamf, update rings or disk encryption checks
No library item drafts an acceptable use policy, or naming, retention and sharing rules for files
No library item reviews admin roles and who holds them across a tenant
No library item tracks breach reporting clocks by region for a small office
No library item offers different layouts of a troubleshooting tree to test with staff
